title: Bound on two Fourier correlations
statement: Let $\phi$ be a nonnegative density of uniform expectation one on the Boolean cube $\mathbb F_2^n$. Suppose $F:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$ satisfies $|F(x)|=1$ for every $x$, and every nonzero Fourier coefficient of $\phi$ has absolute value at most $\varepsilon$. For distinct $\gamma,\eta\in\mathbb F_2^n$, the sum of the $\phi$-weighted correlations of $F$ with the Walsh characters indexed by $\gamma$ and $\eta$ is at most $1+\varepsilon$.
